006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.util;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticMetapathException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModule;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ModelInitializationException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
013
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015
016/**
017 * Provides utility methods for parsing qualified names within Metaschema
018 * modules.
019 */
020public final class ModuleUtils {
021  /**
022   * Parse a flag name.
023   * <p>
024   * The namespace for the name will be determined according to
025   * {@link StaticContext#parseFlagName(String)}.
026   *
027   * @param module
028   *          the containing module
029   * @param name
030   *          the name
031   * @return the parsed qualified name
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  public static IEnhancedQName parseFlagName(
035      @NonNull IModule module,
036      @NonNull String name) {
037    try {
038      return module.getModuleStaticContext().parseFlagName(name);
039    } catch (StaticMetapathException ex) {
040      throw new ModelInitializationException(ex);
041    }
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Parse the name of a field or assembly.
046   * <p>
047   * The namespace for the name will be determined according to
048   * {@link StaticContext#parseModelName(String)}.
049   *
050   * @param module
051   *          the containing module
052   * @param name
053   *          the name
054   * @return the parsed qualified name
055   */
056  @NonNull
057  public static IEnhancedQName parseModelName(
058      @NonNull IModule module,
059      @NonNull String name) {
060    try {
061      return module.getModuleStaticContext().parseModelName(name);
062    } catch (StaticMetapathException ex) {
063      throw new ModelInitializationException(ex);
064    }
065  }
066
067  private ModuleUtils() {
068    // disable construction
069  }
070
071}
